## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (for a bug fix, a test that failed before the fix)
- [ ] Go: `go vet` and the affected module's tests pass
- [ ] Frontend, if touched: `tsc --noEmit`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Docs updated for any changed behaviour, flag or environment variable
- [ ] No credentials, real hostnames, IP addresses or personal paths in the diff
